Keep every other part unchanged: hat, head, face/hair, torso, rear pockets, shoulders, arms/hands, the supporting straight leg and its planted boot, blue garment colors and pixel grid. The supporting boot, the hips and the entire upper body must remain in exactly the same place. Preserve the body's original 32 native pixel height and proportions, do NOT stretch or move the whole farmer. Flat colors and crisp square blocks on the original large-pixel grid. This is a calm low-foot-clearance walk, no high knees, kick or prancing. Deliver ONE corrected sprite in its original position on a real transparent square canvas, no labels, no shadows, no sheet.
